title: Community Media: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
department: Department of Journalism and Mass Communication
programme: Bachelor of Arts in Mass Media and Communication
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain five features of community radio.
While striving to attain Vision 2030, Kenya hopes to employ a number of development strategies, among these being community media.
Outline the importance of community media, with reference to radio, as a strategy for rural development.
What are the possible obstacles that stand in the way of community media at the initial formulation stages as well as during operation?
Describe the process of setting up a community radio.
Examine any five objectives of a community radio.
Explain any five principles of community broadcasting.
Describe how sustainability is seen as a development strategy in community media.
Describe any five qualities of a good community radio manager.
Examine the basic structure of a community radio station.

items.text: Assess any ten contributions of technology to community media.
